summary: NewGenIvf Group Ltd (registrant) entered into a Share Purchase Agreement to acquire an initial 2% equity interest in PredicXion Group Ltd (K25.ai) for $2M total consideration: $1M cash/digital assets plus 666,667 new Class A ordinary shares. A $200k deposit from a prior letter of intent is applied to cash. The agreement includes a 3-month option to acquire up to an additional 8% at $1M per 1% (50% cash/50% stock), bringing aggregate stake to 10%. Closing is subject to customary conditions. Concurrently, K25.ai appointed NewGenIvf as exclusive APAC agent for its AI platform with tiered commissions capped at $5M/year. Watch for completion of closing conditions and potential full option exercise, which would raise the risk-arb focus on valuation and share issuance.
